DIAGNOSIS READY: DiGeorge Syndrome (22q11.2 deletion syndrome) presenting with congenital heart defect (Tetralogy of Fallot), prematurity-related complications, and associated immune/anemia issues.

*Note: This diagnosis is based on the clinical picture of a premature infant with respiratory support history, potential cardiac involvement, and immune/anemia signs, but further diagnostic testing (chromosomal microarray, echocardiogram, CBC, Coombs test) would be required to confirm.*
